about: Triage benchmark (M3-E1): tasks against fixtures/, each with a written contract. `suggested` is the author's tier; `label` is the human reviewer's tier, which is what agreement is measured against. Run: node packages/sidecar/scripts/benchmark-triage.ts

tasks.request: total() ignores the quantity: multiply each item's price by its quantity.

contract.objective: Cart totals count every unit of each item.

acceptanceCriteria.text: total() returns the sum of price × quantity
A test covers an item with quantity above 1

risks: Callers that already multiply by quantity would double-count

tasks.request: Add a short description of the project to the README.

contract.objective: The README says what the project is in a few sentences.

acceptanceCriteria.text: README has a description paragraph under the title

openQuestions: What the project is for isn't in the repository yet

tasks.request: Make `make lint` also run go vet.

contract.objective: The lint target runs go vet before golangci-lint.

acceptanceCriteria.text: make lint runs go vet ./... and fails when it fails

tasks.request: Include the app version in the /health response.

contract.objective: /health reports the version from pyproject.toml.

acceptanceCriteria.text: /health returns {status, version}
The version matches pyproject.toml

tasks.request: Turn on noUncheckedIndexedAccess in tsconfig.

contract.objective: Index access is checked by the compiler.

acceptanceCriteria.text: tsconfig.json sets noUncheckedIndexedAccess
The project still typechecks

risks: New type errors in existing code

tasks.request: Change the app title to "Shopping List".

contract.objective: The app shows Shopping List as its title.

acceptanceCriteria.text: MaterialApp title is Shopping List
Analysis passes

tasks.request: Add coupons: applyCoupon(cart, code) with percentage and fixed-amount coupons, and tests.

contract.objective: Carts can take a percentage or fixed-amount coupon.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Percentage coupons reuse applyDiscount
Fixed-amount coupons never make the total negative
Unknown codes leave the total unchanged

tasks.request: Add GET /sum?a=&b= with chi that returns Add's result as JSON, with a test.

contract.objective: The service answers sums over HTTP.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /sum?a=2&b=3 returns {"sum":5}
Invalid numbers return 400

constraints: Use chi, which go.mod already declares

tasks.request: Add /items endpoints (create, list, get, delete) backed by an in-memory store, with tests.

contract.objective: The API manages items in memory.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each endpoint has a test
Unknown ids return 404
Types check

tasks.request: Add a counter component with increment and reset, wired into main.ts, with a vitest test.

contract.objective: The page has a working counter.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Increment and reset are tested
Lint and types pass

tasks.request: Add a todo screen where items can be added and removed, with widget tests.

contract.objective: Users can keep a simple todo list.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Adding and removing are covered by widget tests
Analysis passes

tasks.request: Implement the ui package's Button with a label and an onClick prop, and a test.

contract.objective: packages/ui exports a usable Button.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Button renders its label and calls onClick
Biome passes

tasks.request: Add JWT authentication: a /login endpoint, and protect every route except /health.

contract.objective: Only logged-in users can call the API.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Requests without a valid token get 401
/health stays public
The signing key comes from the environment

risks: A weak key or missing expiry weakens every route
openQuestions: Where users and passwords come from

tasks.request: Stop committing .env: load settings from environment variables and document them, without leaking secrets.

contract.objective: Configuration comes from the environment, and nothing secret is tracked.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .env is untracked and ignored
Both servers read DEBUG from the environment
The README lists every variable

risks: Secrets already in git history stay there

tasks.request: Use the ui Button in apps/web, and share one Biome config across all packages.

contract.objective: The web app uses the shared Button, and every package lints the same way.

acceptanceCriteria.text: apps/web depends on and imports Button
One Biome config applies to every package

tasks.request: Add a checkout step that charges the cart total through a PaymentProvider interface, with a fake provider for tests.

contract.objective: Carts can be paid through a pluggable payment provider.

acceptanceCriteria.text: checkout charges total() once
A declined payment leaves the cart unpaid

tasks.request: Store sums in PostgreSQL through a repository, with a schema migration.

contract.objective: Computed sums are persisted.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The repository is tested against a test database
The migration creates the table and can be rolled back

tasks.request: Add a CI job that builds the app and deploys it to GitHub Pages on pushes to main.

contract.objective: main is published to GitHub Pages automatically.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The deploy job runs only on main, after build
The job's permissions are the minimum Pages needs

tasks.request: Keep the user's login token in flutter_secure_storage instead of memory.

contract.objective: The login token survives restarts without being stored in plain text.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The token is written and read through flutter_secure_storage
Logging out deletes it

tasks.request: Migrate the Express server to Flask so the project has a single Python backend, keeping every route.

contract.objective: One Python backend serves everything the Express server did.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every Express route exists in Flask with the same behavior
package.json and server.js are gone
The app starts with make run

risks: Clients that call the Node port
openQuestions: Which port the merged server listens on

tasks.request: Move the monorepo to Nx: project graph, caching and build, test and lint targets for every package.

contract.objective: Nx runs every package's tasks with caching.

acceptanceCriteria.text: nx run-many runs build, test and lint for each package
Existing scripts keep working

constraints: Keep pnpm as the package manager
risks: CI and scripts that call pnpm -r directly

tasks.request: Build the app out into a React SPA: routing, a state store, an API client, five pages, and tests for each page.

contract.objective: A multi-page SPA with shared state and an API layer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each page has tests
Lint, types and build pass

tasks.request: Split the API into users, items and orders services, each with its own database, behind a gateway.

contract.objective: Three services and a gateway replace the single app.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each service has its own tests
The gateway routes to all three

openQuestions: How services authenticate to each other

tasks.request: Add multi-tenancy: tenant isolation in every handler, per-tenant configuration, and partitioned data.

contract.objective: Each tenant's requests and data are isolated.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Requests without a tenant are rejected
One tenant can't read another's data
Per-tenant config loads at startup
